hasDismissedAgentSessions.description: [Internal] Comparator for filtering issues bucketed as having all agent sessions dismissed or closed, and no merged agent pull requests.

hasDuplicateRelations.description: Comparator for filtering issues which are duplicates.

hasErroredAgentSessions.description: [Internal] Comparator for filtering issues bucketed as having an errored agent session, no active sessions, and no merged agent pull requests.

hasMergedAgentPullRequests.description: [Internal] Comparator for filtering issues which have agent-session-linked pull requests that were merged.

hasRelatedRelations.description: Comparator for filtering issues with relations.

hasSharedUsers.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have been shared with users outside of the team.

hasSuggestedAssignees.description: [Internal] Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested assignees.

hasSuggestedLabels.description: [Internal] Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested labels.

hasSuggestedProjects.description: [Internal] Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested projects.

hasSuggestedRelatedIssues.description: [Internal] Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested related issues.

hasSuggestedSimilarIssues.description: [Internal] Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested similar issues.

hasSuggestedTeams.description: [Internal] Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested teams.

labels.description: Filters that issue labels must satisfy.

lastAppliedTemplate.description: Filters that the last applied template must satisfy.

needs.description: Filters that the issue's customer needs must satisfy.

or.description: Compound filters, one of which need to be matched by the issue.

parent.description: Filters that the issue parent must satisfy.

priority.description: Comparator for the issues priority. 0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Medium, 4 = Low.

project.description: Filters that the issues project must satisfy.

projectMilestone.description: Filters that the issues project milestone must satisfy.

reactions.description: Filters that the issues reactions must satisfy.

recurringIssueTemplate.description: [ALPHA] Filters that the recurring issue template must satisfy.

releases.description: Filters that the issue's releases must satisfy.

sharedWith.description: Filters that users the issue has been shared with must satisfy.

slaBreachesAt.description: Comparator for the issue's SLA breach date.

slaStatus.description: Comparator for the issues sla status.

snoozedBy.description: Filters that the issues snoozer must satisfy.

snoozedUntilAt.description: Comparator for the issues snoozed until date.

some.description: Filters that needs to be matched by some issues.

sourceMetadata.description: Filters that the source must satisfy.

startedAt.description: Comparator for the issues started at date.

state.description: Filters that the issues state must satisfy.

subscribers.description: Filters that issue subscribers must satisfy.

suggestions.description: [Internal] Filters that the issue's suggestions must satisfy.

team.description: Filters that the issues team must satisfy.

triagedAt.description: Comparator for the issues triaged at date.

updatedAt.description: Comparator for the updated at date.

and.description: Compound filters, all of which need to be matched by the workflow state.

createdAt.description: Comparator for the created at date.

description.description: Comparator for the workflow state description.

issues.description: Filters that the workflow states issues must satisfy.

name.description: Comparator for the workflow state name.

or.description: Compound filters, one of which need to be matched by the workflow state.

position.description: Comparator for the workflow state position.

team.description: Filters that the workflow states team must satisfy.

type.description: Comparator for the workflow state type. Possible values are "triage", "backlog", "unstarted", "started", "completed", "canceled", "duplicate".

updatedAt.description: Comparator for the updated at date.
